g.text: The compositor dims to 35% and desaturates to 40% in 600 ms.
The desktop stays visible: you see what you are about to lose.
Six words, 24 px Manrope, on the left screen edge, 72 px rows.
The underlined first letter is the key. No tiles, no chips,
no dialog box. A 3 px line on the edge slides between them.
Lock cyan through Shut down rose on the state axis. Enter on a
destructive word grows the line to 6 px and starts a 3 s countdown
that shortens it. A second Enter confirms.
The chosen line spreads to fill the screen: the spectrum sweeping
in from the left edge at 20%. Then the action runs.

svg.text: Phosphor · power menu · a column of words over your dimmed desktop
